parsed.rationale: All four records are unnamed `extension` declarations on `String` spread across four distinct packages (`Playlist`, `AnalyticsMacros`, `Analytics`) with no structural evidence provided (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor, and differing_slots are all null) and empty `fields_or_signature` lists on every record. Without knowing which members each extension contributes, there is no grounded basis to assert duplication or overlap. The cluster signal is purely a name-collision on the extended type (`String`), which is a coincidental structural artifact of multiple packages independently extending the Swift standard-library type for their own domain-specific purposes (HTML decoding in `Playlist`, macro synthesis helpers in `AnalyticsMacros`, analytics formatting in `Analytics`). Consolidating these extensions would couple unrelated packages with no demonstrated shared logic.
